jobs.employer_name: Technische Universität München (TUM), TUM Center for QuantumEngineering (ZQE)
jobs.description:
The research group for the Topology of Correlated Systems at the TUM Center for Quantum Engineering (ZQE) and the Department of Physics is looking for a postdoctoral researcher (f/m/d) to join the BMFTR-funded collaborative project “GarliQ - Green Advanced Refrigerants: Light-element oxides & intermetallics for Quantum cooling” at the earliest possible date. The position is initially limited to 3 years, full-time.

GarliQ is a collaborative project between TUM and kiutra GmbH, funded under the BMFTR call “Enabling Technologies for Resilient R&D Supply Chains in Quantum Technologies”. The project aims to develop new materials with magnetocaloric properties for use as cooling media in adiabatic demagnetization refrigeration (ADR) systems in the millikelvin temperature range - key components of the cryogenic infrastructure for quantum technologies.

Independent synthesis of magnetocaloric material systems (oxide and intermetallic compounds) via solid-state synthesis and melt crystal growth
Structural characterization of the synthesized materials, including by X-ray diffraction
Investigation of magnetic and thermodynamic low-temperature properties using standard and dilution refrigerator cryostats; as applicable, experiments at neutron and synchrotron sources
Determination of magnetocaloric parameters (isothermal entropy change, adiabatic temperature change)
Scale-up of promising synthesis routes for integration into ADR cooling systems, in close coordination with the industrial project partner kiutra GmbH
Supervision of PhD students, master's students, and student assistants within the project
Writing scientific publications for peer-reviewed journals
Presentation of results at national and international conferences

Completed doctorate in physics, materials science, chemistry, or a related field
Solid experience in the synthesis of inorganic solids
Knowledge of structural characterization (powder X-ray diffraction, Laue diffraction, microscopy, …)
Experience with magnetic and thermodynamic measurements (magnetometry, susceptibility, heat capacity, …) at low and ultra-low temperatures
Experience operating crystal growth facilities and/or cryostats
Demonstrated publication record in solid-state physics or materials science
Independent, structured way of working and enjoyment of interdisciplinary teamwork
Excellent written and spoken English; knowledge of German is an advantage
Experience supervising students is an advantage
We offer the opportunity to contribute to an internationally visible research topic at the interface of solid-state physics and quantum technologies - in an excellently equipped low-temperature laboratory at the TUM Department of Physics and in close collaboration with an innovative industry partner.
TUM offers a working environment with flexible working hours, flat hierarchies, and open communication, as well as a comprehensive, free range of professional and personal development opportunities.
Remuneration is based on qualifications according to TV-L. TUM aims to increase the proportion of women in its workforce; applications from women are therefore explicitly encouraged.

A Snapshot of Your Day 

Join Siemens Energy’s Transformers factory network as a Operational Excellence Professional (f/m/d) in Germany and help drive greater efficiency, productivity, and shorter lead times. You will lead continuous improvement and cost-reduction initiatives that support profitable revenue growth across multiple manufacturing sites. Working closely with factory teams, you will share best practices, standardize operating methods, and strengthen Lean ways of working. You will use performance data to identify opportunities, solve operational challenges, and support informed decision-making. Your work will help build a more agile, transparent, and efficient manufacturing organization.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Lead process improvement and cost-reduction projects across the Transformers factory network to improve output and cost-effectiveness
* Define project scope, goals, deliverables, and schedules, and collaborate with factory leadership and project sponsors to ensure successful execution
* Facilitate cross-functional workshops and best practice exchanges between manufacturing sites to support operational excellence
* Develop, implement, and maintain standard operating methods, while training and coaching colleagues in Lean methodologies and continuous improvement practices
* Manage operational performance data, monitor KPIs and OKRs, and analyze production and logistics processes to identify inefficiencies and implement data-driven improvements

What You Bring

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a closely related field
* Many years of professional experience in project execution, production, or logistics within a manufacturing environment
* Lean Training or a Lean Certification and/or Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification
* Strong expertise in Lean methodologies, Six Sigma tools, value stream mapping, process optimization, root cause analysis, and problem solving
* Experience in project planning and execution, workshop facilitation, stakeholder and change management, performance monitoring, and cost analysis
* Very good communication in English and German

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

Job Requirements

Do you want to help create the future of healthcare? Our name, Siemens Healthineers, was selected to honor our people who dedicate their energy and passion to this cause. It reflects their pioneering spirit combined with our long history of engineering in the ever-evolving healthcare industry.

We offer you a flexible and dynamic environment with opportunities to go beyond your comfort zone in order to grow personally and professionally. Sounds interesting?

Then come and join our global team as HR Global Process Owner - Total Rewards (f/m/d), for overseeing and improving global HR processes, in the scope of employee lifecycle management (including, Talent Acquisition, Compensation, Benefits) HR Information Systems (HRIS), and payroll-related functions such as time and attendance. The role demands a blend of strategic vision and hands-on execution to lead process design, automation, and standardization in a fast-growing international environment. The HR GPO acts as a change agent and partner to HR stakeholders, managing complex multinational projects and ensuring alignment across regions and functions.

This position can be located at the following locations:
* Erlangen, Germany
* Budapest, Hungary
* Lisbon, Portugal
* Madrid, Spain

Your tasks and responsibilities:

Process Improvement and Management
* Coordinate the end-to-end design, ownership, and continuous enhancement of HR processes globally.
* Initiate process and system changes, prioritize improvement initiatives, and manage project roadmaps for global HR programs.
* Ensure processes comply with jurisdictional regulations while delivering an excellent employee experience and supporting global expansion.
* Develop and approve detailed business process documentation, including current and future state descriptions and business requirements.

Stakeholder Engagement
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across Finance, HR, IT, and other business units to optimize service delivery and leadership models.
* Confirm business readiness prior to deploying new processes or system enhancements and communicate changes to users.
* Collaborate continuously with cross-functional teams to optimize end-to-end time and attendance processes and align transformation roadmaps.

Transformation and Governance
* Partner with HR Operations to define and govern these policies.
* Collaborate with IT, Finance, and Operations to implement and ensure system functionality.
* Establish frameworks to stabilize and sustain outcomes post-launch, driving ownership of execution across teams.
* Apply expertise in global processes and internal controls to assess the impact of process or system changes.
* Demonstrate autonomy and decision-making skills in ambiguous situations.

Change Management
* Collaborate with a team of experts globally to drive changes and transformations.
* Coordinate the transition to standardized, process-driven ways of working across regions.
* Act as a business partner and change agent for HR-stakeholders globally, supporting HR transformation initiatives focused on talent attraction, onboarding, performance management, development, and retention.

Your qualifications and experience:
* You have a university degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration, or related fields; master's degree preferred.
* You have proven many years of experience in global HR process management and HRIS platforms such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday, or Oracle HCM.
* You have very strong knowledge of HR process improvement methodologies like Lean and Six Sigma; certifications such as Lean Six Sigma Black Belt are advantageous.
* You possess excellent project management, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Your attributes and skills:
* You have fluent English language skills; additional languages (especially German) are a plus
* You have the ability to work collaboratively in multicultural and cross-functional environments.
* You bring strong analytical skills and use data to drive decisions and continuous improvement.
* You communicate confidently with senior stakeholders and build strong cross-functional relationships (HR, IT, Procurement, Legal, Finance).
* You are able to simplify complex processes and drive adoption across a global organization.
* You act as a trusted advisor to business leaders on workforce strategies and governance topics.
* You work proactively and take ownership, especially in managing escalations and resolving issues.
* You are comfortable working in a global environment and are willing to travel (approx. 20%).

Our global team:

Siemens Healthineers is a leading global medical technology company. 74,000 dedicated colleagues in over 70 countries are driven to shape the future of healthcare. An estimated 5 million patients across the globe benefit every day from our innovative technologies and services in the areas of diagnostic and therapeutic imaging, laboratory diagnostics and molecular medicine, as well as digital health and enterprise services.

Our culture:

Our culture embraces different perspectives, open debate, and the will to challenge convention. Change is a constant aspect of our work. We aspire to lead the change in our industry rather than just react to it. That's why we invite you to take on new challenges, test your ideas, and celebrate success. Check our Careers Site at https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.#myabilityshs

We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile in our talent community where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open.

To all recruitment agencies:

Do you want to help create the future of healthcare? Our name, Siemens Healthineers, was selected to honor our people who dedicate their energy and passion to this cause. It reflects their pioneering spirit combined with our long history of engineering in the ever-evolving healthcare industry.

We offer you a flexible and dynamic environment with opportunities to go beyond your comfort zone in order to grow personally and professionally. Sounds interesting?

In this role, you will collaborate closely with internationally recognized physicians, Key Opinion Leaders, and leading global partners in the Structural Heart and Electrophysiology space. You will support a broad range of advanced procedures, including transcatheter valve interventions, left atrial appendage (LAA) closure, electrophysiology procedures, and emerging therapies. At the same time, you will help shape the future of interventional imaging by incorporating direct customer feedback and driving clinical innovation in one of the fastest-growing fields of cardiovascular medicine.

Choose the best place for your work - Within the scope of this position, it is possible, in consultation with your manager, to work mobile (within Germany) up to an average volume of 60% of the respective working hours.

Even more flexibility? Mobile working from abroad is possible for up to 30 days a year under certain conditions and in selected countries.

This position can be filled within Germany.

Drive Clinical Adoption

* You support physicians and cath lab/EP teams by providing expert clinical and technical guidance during procedures and enabling the effective use of the AcuNav Lumos 4D ICE Catheter and interventional ultrasound technologies.

Develop Education and Training

* You work closely with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), build trusted relationships, and act as the voice of the customer by gathering clinical insights and supporting continuous product improvement.
* You partner with commercial, marketing, product management, and R&D teams to share clinical feedback and contribute to ongoing innovation and product development.

* You provide clinical expertise to identify customer needs and collaborate with commercial teams to drive successful adoption and account growth.
* You contribute to go-to-market initiatives and customer engagement strategies.

* You have a proven track record of delivering impactful product demonstrations, providing clinical education, and leading physician training sessions in complex clinical environments.
* You bring expert knowledge of clinical procedures, workflow optimization, best practices, troubleshooting techniques, scientific literature, emerging technologies, and competitive developments.

A Snapshot of Your Day 

This position involves the technical and disciplinary leadership of a team of IT/OT technicians, the coordination of IT/OT projects, and the responsibility for maintaining and further developing the local IT/OT infrastructure.
The Local IT Team Lead works closely with other departments to ensure the seamless and high quality delivery of IT/OT services. In addition, he or she, together with the team, is integrated into global support and project structures and provides support for international initiatives as required.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Leadership, guidance, and performance management of the local IT/OT team, including mentoring and feedback
* Coordination and prioritization of local and global IT/OT support requests, including first‑ and second‑line technical support
* Setup, configuration, monitoring, and maintenance of local and global IT/OT infrastructure (servers, networks, security systems, and end‑user devices)
* Planning, leadership, and execution of local and international IT/OT projects and strategic initiatives
* Cross‑functional collaboration with internal departments and the global IT organization to ensure stable operation of the global DT environment and remote site support
* Compliance assurance with IT/OT policies and best practices, including documentation, ticket tracking, continuous process improvement, and evaluation of emerging technologies

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline
* Proven experience in IT/OT support or a comparable role, with leadership experience as an advantage
* Strong knowledge of IT/OT systems, hardware, software, networking, and troubleshooting methodologies
* Familiarity with IT service management frameworks (e.g. ITIL), relevant certifications (e.g. CompTIA A+, Network+), and SAP knowledge as a plus
* Proficiency in the local language and English; additional language skills as an advantage
* Strong personal attributes, including problem‑solving capability, communication skills, attention to detail, customer orientation, adaptability, a hands‑on mindset, and commitment to continuous learning 

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

Stellenbeschreibung:
About HeyGermany

Germany urgently needs international talent. Yet complex and lengthy recognition processes prevent many qualified professionals from working in the jobs they trained for. At the same time, employers struggle to fill critical positions.

HeyGermany wants to change that. We are building the digital infrastructure to make professional recognition and work integration faster and easier. We are starting with nursing and plan to expand into other regulated professions. Our mission is to remove bureaucratic barriers and help international talent access jobs that match their qualifications.

The Role

We are looking for a hands-on, product-driven Founding CTPO with the ambition to build HeyGermany as a co-founder. You will take full ownership of both product and technology, from understanding customer problems and defining our product vision to building, launching and scaling the solutions.

You will work closely with the Founder & CEO to shape company strategy, identify growth opportunities and turn our vision into a product that users love and businesses are willing to pay for.

We already have a live MVP (www.hey-germany.com (http://www.hey-germany.com) ), an initial recognition engine and talent pool, 400+ talent pool conversions, our first enterprise pilot and secured public funding.

Your challenge is to turn this foundation into a scalable, user-centric platform that can take HeyGermany from one profession to many, while building the product and technology capabilities to support long-term growth.

What You’ll Do

- Own our product vision, strategy and roadmap, translating customer needs, business goals and market insights into clear priorities and measurable outcomes.
- Lead product discovery and development end-to-end, from user research, problem validation and prototyping to technical implementation, launch and iteration.
- Own our technology strategy and architecture, building scalable systems for qualification recognition, document processing, workflow automation and talent matching.
- Turn complex regulatory and bureaucratic processes into simple, intuitive digital experiences, with a strong focus on usability, customer value and conversion.
- Stay hands-on in building the product, making key technical decisions across frontend, backend, APIs, data and cloud infrastructure while maintaining a high standard of product quality.
- Identify and develop AI-powered product opportunities where they create real value, particularly in document analysis, structured data extraction, intelligent matching and workflow automation.
- Work directly with international professionals, employers and domain experts to understand their needs, validate assumptions and continuously improve the product.
- Define and track key product metrics, using data, user feedback and experimentation to drive product decisions, engagement, conversion and business outcomes.
- Build and lead our future product and engineering team, establishing a strong culture of ownership, customer focus, speed and continuous learning.

What We’re Looking For

- We care less about your current title than about what you have built, your product judgment and the level of ownership you are ready to take.
- 7+ years of experience in software engineering, product development or technical product leadership, with strong hands-on technical capabilities.
- A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
- A proven track record of building and shipping digital products end-to-end, ideally in a founder, founding engineer, product-minded CTO, technical product lead or similar role.
- Strong product thinking, with the ability to identify real customer problems, validate solutions, prioritize effectively and balance user needs with business impact and technical feasibility.
- Strong experience with a modern web stack, ideally TypeScript, React/Next.js, backend development, APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure.
- Practical experience building with LLMs and modern AI systems, including RAG, agents and evaluations, and using AI effectively in product development and day-to-day work.
- Experience with product discovery, user research, UX principles, product analytics and iterative development. You know how to move from an initial hypothesis to a product that delivers measurable value.
- The ability to make pragmatic decisions across product and technology, balancing speed, user experience, quality and scalability in an early-stage environment.
- A strong understanding of how product decisions connect to business outcomes, including acquisition, activation, retention and monetization.
- A founder mindset and strong connection to our mission**.** You want real ownership, are comfortable with the ambiguity of a pre-seed company and care about building a successful business, not just great technology.
- Strong English communication skills are required. German is a plus.
- Experience with document intelligence/OCR, B2B SaaS, marketplaces, HR Tech, Global Mobility or regulated/GDPR-sensitive products is valuable, but not required.

What We Offer

- €50,000–€65,000 annual base salary, with salary growth as the company scales, plus meaningful equity reflecting the founder-level ownership of the role.
- The opportunity to become a true co-founder, with long-term ownership of product and technology and meaningful participation in the company’s upside.
- Founder-level influence over product vision, technology and company strategy, with the freedom to shape what we build, how we build it and how we grow.
- The opportunity to build our product, technology architecture and future product and engineering organisation from the ground up.
- A live product, early traction, our first enterprise pilot and secured public funding. We are currently in conversations with investors for our next stage of growth.
- The opportunity to work on a problem with tangible social and economic impact: helping international professionals access jobs that match their qualifications while helping employers access talent they urgently need.

We believe professional opportunities should be determined by people’s skills, not by their ability to navigate bureaucracy.

If you want to build both the product and the technology behind a company from the ground up, take real ownership and help shape HeyGermany as a co-founder, we would love to hear from you.

Send us one product you've built that you're proud of, tell us what role you played in bringing it to life, and why this mission matters to you.

jobs.description:
AURELIUS is a global alternative investor, distinguished and widely recognised for its operational approach. It focuses on private markets, in particular Private Equity and Private Debt. Its key investment platforms include AURELIUS Opportunities V, AURELIUS European Opportunities IV, AUR Portfolio III and AURELIUS Growth (Wachstumskapital). AURELIUS has been growing significantly in recent years, especially expanding its global footprint, and today employs more than 400 professionals in 10 offices spanning Europe, North America and Asia.

AURELIUS is driven by a spirit of entrepreneurship, with a collegiate, hands-on approach to complex projects. We are motivated, open, fun, and operate as a team of equals.

Create impact with passion!

For an AURELIUS’ portfolio company located in Bavaria we are looking for a

Head of PMO / Chief of Projects (m/f/d)

As a Head of PMO you will lead and professionalize the end-to-end Project Management / Delivery function across the EMEA utilities business, spanning residential and industrial energy tech, software, and analytics solutions. You will own delivery from project definition through mass production and customer rollout, integrating Sales, Product Management, R&D, NPI, Procurement, and Quality into one disciplined execution engine. Furthermore, you will transform a currently fragmented, product- and site-centric delivery model into a standardized, cross-BU project delivery organization with clear stage gates, transparent KPIs, and predictable outcomes. The Head of PMO will act as the single accountable owner like a “project CEO” for on-time, on-quality, and on-cost delivery of projects and new product introductions, and as the primary interface to major customers for delivery commitments. Your task is to drive execution discipline, cost control, and margin protection across the full project lifecycle. The role requires frequent travel.

Responsibilities

1. Project Delivery Leadership & Organizational Ownership

- Lead and develop the EMEA Project Delivery organization across customer projects, NPI, and cross-BU solution programs
- Define and implement the organizational setup, governance model, and PM career path, including near-/offshore delivery capacity
- Build a balanced delivery organization combining hardware project management, software/solution delivery, and NPI program management
- Ensure scalability, agility, and clear accountability across all delivery units and sites

2. End-to-End Engineering Delivery

- Own end-to-end delivery from project definition through development, industrialization, mass production ramp, and customer handover
- Act as the single point of accountability for on-time, on-quality, on-cost execution of customer projects and NPIs
- Drive execution discipline, cost control, and scalable delivery models across multi-site and multi-BU programs
- Establish a common project lifecycle, stage-gate framework, and PMO standards applied consistently across electricity, gas, thermal, software, and analytics
- Ensure robust project planning, risk management, change control, and claim management on all major programs
- Chair stage-gate reviews and enforce go/no-go decisions against scope, schedule, cost, quality, and business case

3. Cross-BU Solution Delivery (HW + SW + Analytics)

- Lead delivery of integrated solutions combining residential and industrial meters, head-end software, and analytics offerings
- Break down BU silos and orchestrate cross-BU program teams around customer outcomes, not product lines
- Establish shared solution architectures and reusable delivery playbooks across product families
- Ensure consistent solution scoping, pricing input, and delivery commitments across the portfolio

4. NPI & Industrialization

- Collaborate with Operations on NPI program management from early involvement design, to design freeze through pilot, ramp, and stable serial production
- Ensure early and structured involvement of NPI, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Quality in R&D projects
- Drive design-for-manufacturing, design-for-cost, and design-for-serviceability discipline into every new program
- Manage ramp readiness: supply readiness, test coverage, production line qualification, and yield curves

5. Cross-functional Collaboration

- Act as the delivery counterpart to Product Management (portfolio & roadmap) and R&D (technology execution)
- Partner with Sales and Customer Projects to translate customer commitments into feasible, margin-protected delivery plans
- Provide delivery input into bids, contract negotiation, and commercial terms (milestones, LDs, acceptance criteria)
- Collaborate with Procurement and SCM to secure supply, lead times, and cost targets for project ramp
- Collaborate with Quality to embed quality gates and field-performance feedback into delivery governance
- Align with Finance on project controlling, revenue recognition, milestone billing, and cash collection

6. Financial & Resource Management

- Own the project delivery cost base and the aggregated margin performance of the project portfolio
- Drive project margin protection: budget adherence, contingency management, scope and change control
- Optimize allocation of PM and delivery resources across customer projects and NPI programs
- Drive build vs. buy vs. outsource decisions for delivery capacity, balancing control, cost, and flexibility
- Support business cases and mid-term planning with realistic delivery assumptions and risk-adjusted estimates

7. Transformation & Change Leadership

- Lead transformation initiatives to increase delivery productivity, reduce time-to-market, and improve predictability
- Standardize and digitalize PMO tooling (planning, reporting, risk, resource management)
- Build a high-performance, accountable, and customer-centric delivery culture
- Drive upskilling and certification of the PM community across hardware, software, and solution delivery

8. Governance, Risk & Compliance

- Ensure project delivery complies with contractual, regulatory, cybersecurity, and quality requirements
- Establish transparent portfolio reporting to the CEO and executive team, including early warning on at-risk programs
- Own risk register for the delivery portfolio and drive systematic mitigation

Your Profile

Professional Experience

- Minimum 15+ years of experience in project, program, and delivery leadership, including senior roles (VP/SVP level) in an international, matrix organization
- Proven track record leading large-scale, cross-functional delivery organizations spanning hardware, software, and integrated solutions
- Significant experience in customer project delivery in a B2B environment (preferably utilities, energy, industrial technology, or telecom infrastructure)
- Strong NPI and industrialization background: bringing new hardware and software products from development into serial production and customer rollout
- Demonstrated success in owning end-to-end delivery from project definition to mass production and customer acceptance
- Experience running structured stage-gate and PMO frameworks at scale, with measurable improvements in OTD, margin, and predictability
- Solid commercial acumen: contract, bid, and claim management; project P&L ownership; milestone billing and working capital control
- Experience in driving organizational transformation and productivity improvements (cost, efficiency, time-to-market)
- Experience in global/multi-site setups, including near-/offshore delivery structures
- Exposure to carve-out, integration, or major transformation programs (strong plus)

Intercultural Experience

- Proven leadership experience in international and cross-cultural environments, managing teams across multiple geographies
- Strong experience in navigating matrix organizations and global governance structures
- High level of cultural awareness, adaptability, and communication effectiveness at executive and customer level
- Fluency in German and English is a prerequisite

Personal attributes

- University degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
- Advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) is a plus; recognized PM certifications (PMP, IPMA, PgMP, SAFe) are a plus
- Strong technical understanding across hardware, embedded systems, software, and cloud/analytics solutions — able to challenge and steer technical trade-offs
- Deep mastery of project and program management methods, stage-gate governance, and modern delivery models (Agile at scale, hybrid HW/SW delivery)
- Proven ability to drive execution at scale in multi-site, distributed delivery organizations, including vendor and outsourcing management
- Data-driven delivery mindset: use of KPIs, portfolio dashboards, and analytics to improve OTD, quality, and productivity
- Strong business and P&L awareness, with ability to protect and expand project margin under commercial pressure
- Ability to connect customer commitments, technical execution, and financial outcomes
- Strong ROI orientation: able to challenge scope, prioritize based on value, and terminate programs that no longer meet hurdle rates
- Strong decision-making capability under ambiguity, especially in evolving organizational and carve-out setups
- Excellent stakeholder management skills across CEO / board level, customers, suppliers, and internal functions
- High degree of resilience and change leadership capability in transformation environments
- Ability to attract, develop, and retain top program and delivery talent
